title: Yehudah bar Mareimar

paragraphs: Hyman says that Yehudah's father Mareimar presided at Sura after Rav Ashi, as explained in Mareimar’s entry. He describes Yehudah as a colleague of Mar bar Rav Ashi. In Berakhot 45b, Yehudah bar Mareimar, Mar bar Rav Ashi and Rav Acha of Difti ate bread together. None was sufficiently distinguished above his companions to lead the blessing. They came before Mareimar, etc. The supplied notice then breaks off: “And there is…”

notes.text: The supplied Hebrew ends with ויש (“and there are…”). Its continuation is missing.

No new primary scalar was returned. Hyman says Mareimar presided at Sura AFTER Rav Ashi, not after Ravina; מלך denotes academy leadership in this context. All three meal participants and the later visit to Mareimar are preserved, without transferring the title Mar to Yehudah. The supplied notice ends ויש.; no continuation or footnote is reconstructed, and no absence from printed pages is claimed.

Berakhot 45b adds that the three blessed separately and Mareimar told them that they had fulfilled the blessing but missed the joint invitation to recite it. Hyman's printed notice (vol. II, p. 565) ends at ויש. The next notice is separately headed Yehudah Mar bar Mareimar. The frozen notice's ending and Hyman's statement about Sura's succession are preserved.
